title: A Protocol for Multiple Gene Knockout in Mouse Small Intestinal Organoids Using a CRISPR-concatemer
protocol: Design gRNAs against the genes of interest using a CRISPR gRNA design tool.
Ensure that gRNAs do not contain the BbsI recognition site.
Add specific CRISPR-concatemer vector overhangs to each oligo as specified in Table 1.
Prepare the reaction mixture for phosphorylating oligos and annealing top and bottom strands on ice.
Pool together the required number of gRNA top and bottom strands in DNase/RNase-free water.
Mix well by pipetting the pooled gRNA oligos.
Run the pooled oligos through thermocycling with settings: 37 °C for 30 min, 95 °C for 5 min, ramp down to 25 °C at 0.3 °C/min, hold at 4 °C.
Dilute the reaction mixture 1:100 in DNase/RNase-free water.
Assemble the BbsI shuffling reaction on ice using 100 ng CRISPR-concatemer vector and the oligo mixture.
Include a negative control with only the vector.
Add 1.0 µL BSA-containing restriction enzyme buffer (10x).
Add 1.0 µL DTT (10 mM).
Add 1.0 µL ATP (10 mM).
Add 1.0 µL BbsI.
Add 1.0 µL T7 ligase.
Adjust the total volume to 20.0 µL with H2O.
Mix well by pipetting.
Run 50 cycles in a thermocycler for cloning 3 and 4 gRNA-concatemers at 37 °C for 5 min, then 21 °C for 5 min, followed by hold at 37 °C for 15 min, then 4 °C forever.
Run 25 cycles in a thermocycler for 2 gRNA-concatemers at 37 °C for 5 min, then 21 °C for 5 min, followed by hold at 37 °C for 15 min, then 4 °C forever.
Treat the BbsI shuffling reaction with DNA exonuclease.
Take 11.0 µL ligation mix from a previous step.
Add 1.5 µL exonuclease buffer (10x).
Add 1.5 µL ATP (10 mM).
Add 1.0 µL DNA exonuclease.
Bring the total volume to 15.0 µL with water.
Incubate at 37 °C for 30 min.
Incubate at 70 °C for 30 min.
Use 2 µL of the reaction mixture for transformation into chemically competent E. coli bacteria by heat shock.
Alternatively, store the reaction for up to one week at -20 °C.
Assess the success of the cloning procedure by restriction digestion.
Pick 4 - 8 bacterial colonies with an inoculating loop.
Grow each clone in 4 mL of LB medium overnight at 37 °C in an orbital shaker.
Extract DNA using a plasmid miniprep kit according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Digest ~200 ng of DNA with 10 U EcoRI + 5 U BglII in a 10 μL reaction by incubating it at 37 °C for 3 h in a bacteria incubator.
Include a separate reaction mixture with the corresponding original vector as a positive control for size comparison.
Run digestion reactions on a 1% agarose gel at 90 V for approximately 20 min.
Visualize the gel using a UV transilluminator.
Identify the clones with correct insert size by ensuring their band pattern matches the one of the original vector and that each fragment has the expected size by using a DNA ladder.
Digest the selected clones with 5 U BbsI at 37 °C for 3 h in a bacteria incubator.
Include a separate reaction mix with the corresponding original vector as a control.
Run digestion reactions on a 1% agarose gel at 90 V for approximately 20 min.
Confirm positive concatemer vectors by Sanger sequencing using the following primers:
Use Forward primer TCAAGCCCTTTGTACACCCTAAG to check the first gRNA cassette.
Use Linker1_Forward primer GACTACAAGGACGACGATGACAA to check the second gRNA cassette.
Use Linker2_Reverse primer GGCGTAGTCGGGCACGTCGTAGGGGT to check the second gRNA cassette.
Use Linker2_Forward primer ACCCCTACGACGTGCCCGACTACGCC to check the third gRNA cassette.
Use Linker3_Reverse primer TCCTCCTCTGAGATCAGCTTCTGCAT to check the third gRNA cassette.
Use Reverse primer AGGTGGCGCGAAGGGGCCACCAAAG to check the last gRNA cassette.
Check the presence of all gRNA by searching their sequences in the sequencing reads.
Remove antibiotics and conditioned media from mouse intestinal organoids prior to electroporation.
Split organoids in a 1:2 ratio on day 0 of the transfection procedure.
Seed the split organoids in 20 μL basement matrix drops and grow them in WENR + Nic medium at 37 °C, 5% CO2 in a humidified incubator.
On day 2, change the medium to EN (EGF + Noggin) + CHIR99021 (GSK-3 inhibitor) + Y-27632 (ROCK inhibitor), without antibiotics.
On day 3, change the organoid medium again to EN + CHIR99021 + Y-27632 + 1.25% v/v DMSO, without antibiotics.
On day 4, disrupt the basement matrix domes using a 1 mL pipette tip and transfer organoids to a 1.5 mL tube.
Pool contents of four wells of a 48-well plate into one tube.
Mechanically break organoids into small fragments by pipetting up and down with a P200 pipette approximately 200 times.
Centrifuge at room temperature, 5 min at 600 x g.
Remove the medium and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of cell culture grade recombinant protease.
Incubate at 37 °C for a maximum of 5 min.
Check a 50-µL drop of sample under an inverted light microscope with a 4x objective.
Transfer the cell suspension to a low-binding 15 mL tube and halt the dissociation by adding 9 mL of basal medium without antibiotics.
Centrifuge at room temperature, 5 min at 600 x g.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of reduced serum medium.
Count the number of cells with a Bürker's chamber and use a minimum of 1 x 10^5 cells per electroporation reaction.
Add 9 mL reduced serum medium to the 15 mL tube.
Centrifuge at room temperature, 3 min at 400 x g.
Remove all of the supernatant from the cell pellet.
Resuspend the cell pellet in an electroporation solution.
Add a total of 10 µg DNA to the cell suspension, using CRISPR-concatamer vectors and a Cas9 expression plasmid in a 1:1 ratio.
Add electroporation solution to reach a final volume of 100 μL.
Keep the cell-DNA mixture on ice.
Include a separate transfection mix containing a GFP plasmid for efficiency evaluation.
Transfer the cell-DNA mixture to an electroporation cuvette.
Measure the impedance using the electroporator and ensure it is within the range of 0.030-0.055 kΩ.
Adjust the solution volume if necessary to maintain impedance within the allowed range.
Perform electroporation according to specified settings.
Add 400 µL of electroporation buffer + Y-27632 to the cuvette after electroporation.
Transfer the mixture into a 1.5 mL tube.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 min.
Spin the cells at room temperature for 3 min at 400 x g to recover.
Remove the supernatant from the cells.
Resuspend the pellet in 20 μL/well of basement matrix.
Seed approximately 1 x 104 to 1 x 105 cells per well in a 48-well plate.
Add EN + CHIR99021 + Y-27632 + 1.25% v/v DMSO medium to the wells.
Incubate at 37 °C.
On day 5, change the medium to EN + CHIR99021 + Y-27632.
Check transfection efficiency by observing GFP expression.
Refresh EN + CHIR99021 + Y-27632 medium after 2 days.
On day 9, change the medium to WENR + Nic + Y-27632.
Incubate at 37 °C.
Remove Y-27632 after 7-10 days (on day 16-19).
Split organoids in a 1:3 ratio in a 48-well plate 10-14 days after electroporation.
Resuspend the organoid pellet in 20 µL of basement membrane matrix.
Let it solidify at 37 °C for 10 min.
Overlay 250 µL of growth factor-deprived medium (e.g., EN) to test knockout of target genes.
Split the organoids under growth factor-deprived conditions for a minimum of 2 - 3 passages.
